parameters.content:
## HubSpot Ticket SLA Escalation Router
Monitors open HubSpot tickets, measures first-response and resolution time against P1/P2/P3 SLA tiers, and escalates neglected tickets via HubSpot tasks, Slack and email.

**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` sends every planned action to *Dry-Run Telemetry* instead of HubSpot, Slack or email.

**Setup:** set environment variables (see `.env.example`), create the custom ticket properties, then select your own HubSpot, Slack and SMTP credentials on the highlighted nodes.

Code nodes are generated from `src/` by `npm run build`. Do not edit them by hand.

nodes.name: Build Search Request
nodes.notes: Validates configuration (fail fast) and builds the HubSpot search body for open tickets.

nodes.name: HubSpot Ticket Search
nodes.notes: Paginated CRM search (up to 10 pages). Errors continue as items so the evaluator can report them.

nodes.name: Evaluate SLA & Plan Escalations
nodes.notes: Core SLA engine. Emits run_summary, ticket_update, task_create, slack_digest and email_digest items.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs sanitized planned actions. Nothing is written or sent.

nodes.name: Route Escalation Actions
nodes.notes: run_summary items match no rule and are intentionally dropped here.

nodes.name: HubSpot Update Ticket
nodes.notes: Writes sla_escalation_level, sla_status and sla_last_escalated_at. Batched to respect HubSpot rate limits.

nodes.name: HubSpot Create Task
nodes.notes: Creates a follow-up task associated with the ticket, assigned to the owner or the fallback owner.

nodes.name: Slack Block Kit Builder
nodes.notes: Renders the escalation digest as Slack Block Kit.

nodes.name: Slack Escalation Alert
nodes.notes: On failure, the error output posts the same digest to SLACK_FALLBACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $('Slack Block Kit Builder').item.json.fallbackText, blocks: $('Slack Block Kit Builder').item.json.blocks }) }}

nodes.name: Slack Fallback Webhook
nodes.notes: Fallback path. Reads the webhook URL from the SLACK_FALLBACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable.
